data.name: NILSH
data.detailed_description:
Discover a world where nature is fading.

NILSH is a top-down action-adventure game where you'll explore a carefully crafted fantasy world while uncovering the secrets of an ancient civilization consumed by a mysterious corruption. Journey through forests, caves, forgotten temples, and many other locations filled with mysteries, memorable characters, and challenges that will test both your wit and your skills.

Become the new Nilsh Emissary and set out on a journey to reunite the surviving communities, restore the bonds between them, and uncover what happened to the balance that once allowed this world to thrive.

Explore a world on the brink of collapse

Venture through a vast interconnected world where every region offers new paths, hidden secrets, and rewarding discoveries. Unlock new tools and abilities that allow you to access previously unreachable areas, revisit familiar locations, and uncover everything the world of NILSH has to offer.

Follow the trail of the Ancients

Explore ancient ruins, solve environmental puzzles, and conquer mysterious dungeons as you decipher a forgotten language and piece together the story of a civilization that once lived in harmony with nature. Every discovery brings you one step closer to unraveling the truth behind this fallen world.

Master dynamic and customizable combat

Combine the power of your Espala with a wide variety of tools and abilities to battle corrupted creatures and challenging bosses. Adapt your combat style, experiment with different strategies, and find the best way to protect the future of the Nilsh people.

Features

  • Explore a vast interconnected world filled with hidden secrets, shortcuts, and rewarding discoveries.

  • Battle corrupted creatures and challenging bosses in fast-paced real-time combat.

  • Solve environmental puzzles and unlock new abilities to reach previously inaccessible areas.

  • Experience a story about hope, curiosity, and the fragile balance of nature.

  • Meet memorable characters, help rebuild scattered communities, and uncover the secrets of a forgotten civilization.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
